title: Full Stack AI Developer
job_description:
Tentang Peran Ini

Kami mencari seorang Full Stack AI Engineer yang dapat menjembatani kesenjangan antara Kecerdasan Buatan (AI) tingkat lanjut dan pengembangan aplikasi skala produksi. Dalam peran ini, Anda tidak hanya akan membangun logika AI backend dan mengintegrasikan Large Language Models (LLM); Anda juga akan merancang dan mengembangkan antarmuka pengguna (UI) serta arsitektur sistem secara keseluruhan yang membuat alat-alat ini dapat diakses oleh tim Operasional, Produk, dan Engineering kami. Anda akan memegang kendali penuh atas seluruh siklus hidup produk AI internal, mulai dari penyimpanan vektor basis data (vector database) hingga frontend.

Tanggung Jawab Utama

Pengembangan Aplikasi AI End-to-End

Merancang, membangun, dan memelihara alat dan dasbor berkemampuan AI secara full-stack, memastikan integrasi yang mulus antara frontend (UI) dan layanan AI backend.

Mengembangkan antarmuka pengguna yang intuitif (menggunakan React) yang memungkinkan pemangku kepentingan non-teknis untuk berinteraksi dengan agen AI yang kompleks, chatbot, dan alur kerja otomatisasi.

Integrasi AI & Backend Development

Mengintegrasikan model bahasa (LLM) dan komponen AI ke dalam platform yang ada menggunakan Python dan kerangka kerja modern (misalnya, LangChain, LangGraph).

Merancang arsitektur dan mengembangkan RESTful API yang tangguh untuk menyajikan output model AI ke aplikasi klien dengan latensi yang rendah.

Mengimplementasikan pipeline RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), mengelola basis data tradisional (SQL) maupun basis data vektor untuk pengambilan konteks yang efisien.

Kolaborasi & Strategi

Bekerja sama erat dengan pemangku kepentingan lintas fungsi (Operasional, Produk) untuk menerjemahkan tantangan/masalah bisnis menjadi solusi AI full-stack.

Infrastruktur & Kualitas

Membantu dalam persiapan data, pengujian model, dan penerapan (deployment) aplikasi dalam kontainer (Docker/Kubernetes) ke lingkungan cloud.

Berpartisipasi dalam tinjauan desain (design review) dan tinjauan kode (code review) untuk tumpukan frontend dan backend guna memastikan standar rekayasa yang tinggi.

Memantau performa model dan aplikasi yang telah diterapkan, menyiapkan observabilitas baik untuk kesehatan sistem (latensi/kesalahan) maupun kualitas model (halusinasi/akurasi).

Persyaratan

Pendidikan & Pengalaman

Gelar Sarjana di bidang Ilmu Komputer, Teknik, atau bidang terkait.

Pengalaman pengembangan perangkat lunak selama 2+ tahun dengan fokus pada pengembangan web full-stack.

Keterampilan Teknis (Full Stack)

Frontend: Kemahiran dalam kerangka kerja JavaScript/TypeScript modern (React) dan prosesor CSS (Tailwind, SASS) untuk membangun antarmuka yang responsif.

Backend: Kemahiran tingkat ahli dalam Python (untuk beban kerja AI) dan pengalaman dengan kerangka kerja web (FastAPI, Django, atau Flask). Berpengalaman dengan Node.js.

Basis Data: Pemahaman yang kuat tentang SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL) dan pengalaman dengan Basis Data Vektor (Pinecone, Milvus, atau pgvector).

Kemampuan AI & ML

Terbiasa dengan alat dan kerangka kerja AI modern (misalnya, LangChain, LangGraph, Transformers, OpenAI API).

Pemahaman yang kuat tentang konsep-konsep utama AI: Prompt Engineering, Embeddings, pipeline RAG, dan sistem Multi-Agent.

Dasar-dasar Ilmu Komputer yang kuat: algoritma, struktur data, dan desain sistem.

DevOps & Penerapan (Deployment)

Memiliki pengalaman dalam menerapkan sistem AI dan aplikasi web di tahap produksi (misalnya, pipeline CI/CD, kontainer Docker, AWS/GCP/Azure).

Pengalaman mengelola state dan tugas asinkron (misalnya, Redis, Celery, RabbitMQ) untuk menangani pekerjaan inferensi AI yang berjalan lama.

Soft Skill

Pola pikir analitis dan pemecahan masalah yang kuat dengan kemauan untuk bereksperimen dan melakukan iterasi.

Semangat untuk membangun sistem AI yang praktis dan andal yang mampu memecahkan masalah internal nyata dalam skala besar.

Mengapa Bergabung dengan Kami?

Peluang untuk bekerja di perusahaan yang dinamis dan berkembang dengan komitmen terhadap inovasi.

Lingkungan kerja kolaboratif dengan fokus pada pembelajaran dan pengembangan berkelanjutan.

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Middle AI Engineer to join our engineering team at PT Fata Organa Solusi. title: AI Scraper Engineer

AI Scraper Engineer

We’re hiring an engineer to design and run server-side scraping systems—including custom scrapers—that stay reliable as targets change and defenses tighten. What you’ll do

Build and maintain production-grade scrapers in Python (and supporting tooling), from HTTP/API clients to headless browser flows where needed.

Reverse-engineer sites and mobile/web apps: discover internal/private APIs, headers, auth flows, pagination, and rate limits; document findings for the team.

Operate in the full “scraping stack”: proxies (residential/datacenter/mobile rotation), TLS/JA3, browser fingerprints, cookies/sessions, CAPTCHA/mitigation strategies where ethical and legal.

Use Playwright (or equivalent) for high-defense targets where pure HTTP isn’t enough; keep runs stable, observable, and cost-aware.

Collaborate remotely with fluent English (written and spoken) for specs, incidents, and architecture discussions with our team.

Use AI coding assistants (e.g. Cursor, Codex, ChatGPT-class tools) as a normal part of workflow—shipping fixes and features fast while preserving code quality, security, and performance.

2+ years professional experience building scrapers, crawlers, or data-ingestion pipelines against real, changing websites.

Strong Python for networking, async I/O, parsing (HTML/JSON), error handling, retries, and structured logging.

Practical grasp of HTTP/HTTPS, REST/JSON (and common variations), cookies, redirects, CORS (from a client perspective), and basic TLS implications for scraping.

Hands-on experience with proxies, IP rotation, session stickiness, and anti-bot concepts (fingerprints, headers, behavioral signals).

Playwright or Selenium-class automation for difficult sites.

Comfortable debugging with DevTools, mitmproxy/Charles-class tools, HAR captures, and reading minified JS when tracing API calls.

Professional English for daily collaboration with English-only stakeholders.

Nice-to-have

How we work

Hybrid model: remote to start; later combination of remote and in-person as agreed.

We value engineers who iterate quickly with AI tools but still own outcomes: correctness, edge cases, security (secrets, customer data), and operational stability.

To apply

Send a short note on two scraping projects you’ve shipped (stack, defenses faced, how you kept them running), plus anything relevant on Playwright, proxy/fingerprint setups, or AI-assisted development.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer-Laravel + Vue
job_description:
About the Role

We're hiring a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to build and own core product features for a real-world workforce management application. This is a hands-on, end-to-end engineering role — you'll design data models, build APIs, and ship polished interfaces that people use daily to enter, track, and manage operational data.

This is not a ticket-based role. You'll be given loosely defined problems and expected to make good decisions quickly — about data structure, business logic, validation, and user experience — without needing detailed specifications.

If you're most comfortable when requirements are fully defined and someone else makes the architecture decisions, this role isn't the right fit. If you enjoy owning problems from schema design through to the UI, and you care about building things that actually work well in the hands of real users, you'll thrive here.

What You'll Be Building

Much of the work involves applications where data relationships matter and correctness is non-negotiable — think time tracking, payroll, compliance, and operational workflows. Concretely, you'll be:

Designing and implementing relational database schemas with complex entity relationships (many-to-many, company-scoped data, cascading constraints)

Building REST APIs in Laravel that enforce business rules at the backend — not just the frontend

Writing Eloquent models with well-structured relationships, scopes, and validation logic

Building Vue 3 interfaces using the Composition API that handle data-heavy, repetitive workflows efficiently

Implementing cascading, context-aware UI components (e.g. dropdowns that filter based on prior selections)

Ensuring interfaces are keyboard-friendly and optimized for fast, high-volume data entry

Displaying clear, row-level validation feedback when backend rules are violated

Caching API responses and optimizing queries for performance at scale

Seeding realistic data and writing clean migrations

What We're Looking For

5+ years of Laravel in production — not tutorial projects, but systems with real users, real data, and real constraints

Strong relational database design skills — you can model a complex domain from scratch and get the relationships right the first time

Deep familiarity with backend validation — you know why frontend-only validation isn't enough and how to enforce business rules server-side

Vue 3 Composition API fluency — you write with setup(), ref, computed, and watch naturally, not by translating Options API habits

Experience building data-entry or operational interfaces — dashboards, admin tools, internal systems where UX and speed of interaction matter

Ability to own features end-to-end with minimal direction, making sound technical decisions independently

Strong instinct for what to build vs. what to skip under time constraints

AI-Native Engineering

We expect AI tools to be a core part of how you work — not an occasional shortcut. You should be able to:

Break down a complex feature into well-structured prompts that produce usable output

Iterate on and refine AI-generated code, catching mistakes and improving the result

Use AI to accelerate both backend (Laravel, migrations, validation logic) and frontend (Vue components, UX patterns) development

Guide an AI model toward a better solution, not just accept whatever it generates first

How you work with AI is part of how we evaluate engineering quality.

Bonus

Experience with Vite and Pinia in Vue 3 projects

Laravel performance optimization — query tuning, caching strategies, eager loading

Background building 0→1 products at early-stage startups

Strong UX instincts for data-entry workflows — keyboard navigation, inline validation, row duplication, smart defaults

Senior Unity Developer

(WebGL, WebGPU, AR & Cross-Platform)




About the Role

Idea Comindo is seeking an experienced and highly creative Senior Unity Developer to join our team. In this role, your primary focus will be on the presentation layer-acting as the bridge between our robust NestJS backend and the end-user. You will be responsible for designing, building, and optimizing interactive frontend applications and games across multiple platforms (WebGL, WebGPU, Desktop, Mobile, and AR).

The ideal candidate is a frontend specialist who writes clean C# code and Unity Game Engine expert, excels at consuming backend data (REST/GraphQL), understands deep performance optimization, and thrives in a results-driven environment.


Key Responsibilities

• Frontend Data Integration: Connect the Unity client to our NestJS backend via REST APIs and GraphQL, ensuring seamless asynchronous data flow and real-time state updates without blocking the main thread.

• Geospatial Visualization: Translate raw geospatial coordinates and map data provided by the backend into accurate, performant 3D visual representations within the Unity environment, managing floating-point rendering challenges.

• AI State Rendering: Consume AI-driven responses from the backend to trigger dynamic visual states, UI updates, and character behaviors in real-time.

• Artwork & Animation Implementation: Integrate 3D models, textures, and UI elements. Utilize Unity's Animator, Timeline, and visual effects tools to create polished, fluid frontend experiences optimized for web and mobile.

• Cross-Platform Build & Optimization: Profile and optimize applications to ensure maximum performance, focusing on reducing draw calls, managing memory, and optimizing assets specifically for WebGL, WebGPU, and Mobile browsers.


Technical Requirements

• Core Engine: High proficiency in Unity/Unity3D and robust knowledge of C# programming.

• Platform Expertise: Proven experience building for WebGL, WebGPU, and Desktop (Windows/MacOS). Familiarity with HTML5, JavaScript, and web browser performance optimization is essential.

• AR Development: Hands-on experience with AR frameworks such as ARKit, ARCore, and Vuforia. Solid understanding of both marker-based and marker-less tracking.

• API & Data: Strong practical experience consuming REST APIs and GraphQL endpoints within Unity, including handling JSON/data serialization for frontend rendering.

• Art Pipeline: Solid understanding of the 3D art pipeline (importing FBX/OBJ, materials, shaders, lighting, rigging) and optimizing those assets for constrained platforms.

• Version Control: Proficient in using Git and standard version control workflows.


Experience & Educational Background

• Experience: Minimum of 4 years of professional experience in Unity development, with a proven portfolio of published WebGL, WebGPU, Desktop, and/or AR projects.

• Education: D3 or Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field is preferred.




Soft Skills

• Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate technical concepts to designers and backend developers.

• Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.

• Creativity: A keen eye for detail, strong visual sense, and an innovative approach to interactive experiences.

Test and validate web dashboards, API integrations, and overall platform functionality to ensure high-quality user experience.
Execute comprehensive testing strategies including integration testing, end-to-end testing.
Identify, document, and track software defects throughout the development lifecycle, working closely with the development team to ensure timely resolution.
